tier.description: Triage tier. The two use GENUINELY different models — this is what makes the cost actually diverge instead of just the label.

triggeredBy.description: `manual` is the reanalysis requested by a human.

supersedes.description: Id of the analysis this one replaces.

eventCountAtAnalysis.description: Log size at the time of the analysis — the snapshot it saw.

costMicros.description: Real cost in micro-USD, summed from the round's `token_usage`. There is only a row here for a COMPLETED run: a failed run does not record one, on purpose.

hypothesisCount.description: How many hypotheses the round yielded.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Project, session, or hypothesis does not exist.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
